maya: Heads-up — account acct_8421 (mike@disposablemail.org) got auto-blocked on free-trial. Customer says they're on corporate VPN. Flags: disposable_email, ip_rotation, billing_address_mismatch. Link: https://app.redwood.com/admin/accounts/8421
fraud-signal-bot: Automated fraud alert · risk_score=0.82 · reasons=[disposable_email, tor_exit_ip, billing_mismatch]
sam_support: Replied to customer asking them to: 1) disable VPN, 2) try a non-temp email, 3) provide a screenshot of billing address they entered. Asked if we can manually grant while they verify.
eli_fraud: Can you paste the signup headers/logs? Quick glance — IP resolves to Tor exit node (ASN 12345). Disposable domain match via our list. If this is a legitimate corporate trial, we can manual-grant after phone OTP + audit note. Otherwise we should keep blocked. Also have customer IP TTL showing rotation.
maya: Paste of headers:
```
POST /signup 200
headers: { "x-forwarded-for": "185.220.100.5", "user-agent": "curl/7.68.0", "x-email": "mike@disposablemail.org" }
body: {"billing_address": "123 W. Elm St, Suite 2", "card_last4": "0000"}
```
alex_ops: If we manually override, we need a support ticket with reason and attach the OTP verification screenshot. I'll create a short-lived override and set audit tag `manual_trial_override`.
customer_success: Suggest 14-day trial after phone verification and a LinkedIn/company domain check. Also recommend that CS runs a quick billing follow-up next week.
maya: Sounds good. Replied to customer: asked them to send a photo of a government ID + phone OTP. Offered a conditional 14-day trial pending verification. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
eli_fraud: Once they send OTP and ID, forward to me in DM. I'll approve and log it. Keep the manual grant window short (14d) and set auto-revoke if any chargeback indicators appear.
sam_support: OK created ticket SUP-2025-1284, linked account, attached logs. Manual grant pending fraud approval. :white_check_mark: 
maya: Update: customer submitted OTP (phone ending ..4321) and a company ID scan. I DM'd @eli_fraud with attachments. Requesting manual grant now.
eli_fraud: Approved after review. I applied `manual_trial_override` for 14 days, added audit note with my initials and case id. Also added playbook note: add phone verification step for disposable email flags.
maya: Resolved with customer — trial activated for 14 days. Logged all artifacts in SUP-2025-1284. Closing thread. :tada:
